reason: The cited evidence shows that FeCrAl coatings form a protective alumina scale (E1) and that PVD produces high-quality Cr coatings (E2), but it provides no direct support for the key premises that Al doping in a Cr coating will form an interfacial Al2O3 scale or that such a scale will limit Cr–Zr interdiffusion while preserving oxidation resistance.
premises: Al doping in Cr coating forms a stable Al2O3 interfacial scale
Cr-Al alloy coating maintains oxidation resistance of Cr matrix
FeCrAl coatings form protective alumina scale at high temperature
PVD is suitable for depositing high-quality Cr-based coatings
